name: GaussianShader Material Model
definition: Enhances 3DGS by incorporating trainable material parameters: diffuse dp, specular sp, roughness ρp, and normal np, along with a global environment map.
summary: GaussianShader enhances 3D Gaussian Splatting with physically-based material parameters, distinguishing itself by disentangling geometry from material properties for accurate specular reflections and relighting.
